about.metaDescription: The story behind Morning Brew (demo project).
about.title: About us
about.lead: This is a fictional coffee shop built for a portfolio. The story below is demo content.
story: Morning Brew imagines a small shop in the neighborhood: a reliably good latte for people rushing to work, and a place for friends to linger over a fresh croissant on weekends.
We believe good coffee doesn't need to be complicated — just fresh beans, careful brewing, and a space that makes you want to stay a little longer.

values.title: Consistency
values.text: We calibrate the grinder and extraction every morning so the last cup is as good as the first.

values.title: Freshness
values.text: Beans are roasted in small batches and pastries baked daily; nothing is kept for tomorrow.

values.title: Comfort
values.text: Plenty of space between tables, and online booking on weekends so nobody queues at the door.

privacy.metaDescription: How Morning Brew (demo project) handles reservation data.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This website is a portfolio demo project (fictional business).

items.title: What we collect
items.text: The reservation form collects your name, email, phone (optional), party size, date, time slot and notes, only to demonstrate the booking flow.

items.title: Where it is stored
items.text: Data is stored in a Supabase database protected by Row Level Security, so only staff accounts can view reservations.

items.title: Abuse prevention
items.text: The form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to check that submissions come from a person, not a bot.

items.title: Third-party services
items.text: The map on the home page is provided by OpenStreetMap and only connects after you click “Load map”.

items.title: Please don't enter real data
items.text: This is a demo project. Please do not enter real personal information; demo data is cleared regularly.
